0022600137.text: The Knicks (1-3) come into their fifth game of the season sitting 12th in the East and 2 games back in the Atlantic, with a win in their most recent game, and they are 0-1 on the road. The Bulls (1-3) are 11th in the East and 2 games back in the Central, having lost their last two games. The Knicks won their only meeting last season 3-1 in the series and beat Chicago 136-96 in New York in their most recent matchup, and no games have been played between the teams yet this season. New York is without Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain), while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), with Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle) listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions.
